annotations.title: Check auto insurer financial strength and complaint lookup

description: Factual carrier standing lookup for US auto insurers: verified AM Best or Demotech financial strength rating status (active, withdrawn, or not rated), underwriting subsidiary notes, eligibility restrictions, public regulatory context, and direct NAIC Consumer Insurance Search lookup guidance (1.00 baseline). Optionally cross-references presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov pricing study. Carriers outside the verified registry return unknown rather than estimated ratings. Factual reference data only; does not endorse insurers.

carrier_name.description: Auto insurance brand or underwriting company name (e.g. 'First Acceptance', 'GEICO Secure', 'CSAA', 'Tesla Insurance', 'Branch').

state.description: Optional two-letter US state code or state name to cross-reference presence in RateZip's 10-state .gov study.
